maria: Starting Terraform apply window in 30m (target 21:00 UTC). Need to drain the apply queue and lockdown module/provider versions across repo. Deploybot scheduled to kick at 2139876800. Who can own rollout + rollback?

aj: Ack. I can own the rollout. I'll watch canaries and metrics. Locking module versions now.

sam: On it — I'll run preflight checks and drain any pending tf runs. ETA ~10m.

sam: Running preflight command:
```
# local preflight
deploybot preflight --check-queues --tfdir infra/terraform
```

deploybot: Preflight run queued (id: 8821). Blocking items: 2 pending PRs that touch `modules/` versions. Draining local apply queue — 3 active runs will be allowed to finish, then new runs blocked.

leo: I'll prepare exact pins for the modules/providers. Example snippet I'll commit to `modules/network/versions.tf`:
```
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@.../vpc.git?ref=v1.4.2"
}
```

ops-oncall: Rollback policy (formalizing): if error rate > 5% OR p50 latency increases > 30% for 10m, trigger rollback to `release/v1.18.0`. Immediate stop command:
`/deploybot cancel-run 8821` or `/deploybot rollback tag=release/v1.18.0`

aj: Also adding CI guard: block merges that bump `versions.tf` unless PR has `/infra-override` label and two infra approvals.

maria: Two PRs to merge: #432 pin modules, #431 drain-queue. After merge I'll trigger the plan. @deploybot please hold the apply until I post 'GO'.

deploybot: Plan started for run 8821.
Plan highlights: no IAM deletions detected, 1 route table update, 2 security group modifications. Plan artifacts at https://ci.internal/runs/8821/plan. Needs infra-owner signoff for SG changes.

sam: Plan reviewed — SG changes are additive with narrow ports. I'll run canary: 10% traffic to az-a for 15m.

leo: Canary running. Monitoring metrics (errors, latencies). If all green, ready to proceed.

aj: CI rule added to `infra-ci.yml` to enforce version lockdown. Merged.

maria: Merged both PRs. GO from me in 5m. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Apply started at 2139876733. Status: success. Outputs: route table updated, SGs applied. No rollbacks triggered. Full logs: https://ci.internal/runs/8821/log

maria: Great work team — tagging release notes and updating rollout tracker. Thanks :tada:
